directory_policies.notes.12: GPA policy: Graduate College baseline 3.0/4 over the last two undergraduate years. Below-floor limited-status and nonstandard cases require university review.

source_excerpt: for last two years of undergraduate study
fact_summary: The Graduate College baseline is 3.0 on a 4.0 scale or a comparable GPA over the last two years of undergraduate study. Program-supported limited status can require Graduate College approval.
